SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 8.2.1 Fluency in Sign Reading Texts of about 400 words, part of Strand 8 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five General.

Key inquiry question: How long do you take to sign read a text?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Suggested Vocabulary to be signed:

virus, hygiene, bacteria, tuberculosis, measles, pneumonia, cold, mumps, cholera, typhoid, parasite, infect, germs, illness, symptoms, vomit, pharmacy,

treat, dose, blood pressure, weight loss, injection, tablet, vaccine, fever, medicine, syrup, laboratory, cure, outbreak, epidemic, immunity.

Fixed phrase: at last, from time to time, in future.

Simile: as helpless as a baby, as patient as job.

Idiom: spread like wildfire.

Proverb: An apple a day keeps the doctor away, Cleanliness is next to godliness.

Phrasal verb: pass away.
